source: This is also why cross-paper bandwidth numbers require caution. Different precisions, tensor shapes, cache states, clocks, ECC settings, and byte-counting conventions can make superficially similar GB/s figures incomparable.
zh: 这也是为什么跨纸带宽数字需要谨慎。不同的精度、张量形状、缓存状态、时钟、ECC 设置和字节计数约定可能会使表面上相似的 GB/s 数字变得无法比较。
